args.query: axios-retry retry on network errors and 5xx with exponential delay

results.title: Axios + axios-retry with exponential backoff, tested with nock
results.summary: Configure axios-retry for idempotent requests and 429/5xx responses, tested offline with nock intercepts.

results.title: axios typed API client with axios-mock-adapter
results.summary: Build a typed axios client with a baseURL and an auth header interceptor, then mock GET, POST, 404, network error and timeout offline while asserting parsed data, the header seen by the mock and error handling.

results.title: undici HTTP client with p-retry backoff, tested with MockAgent
results.summary: A JSON client on undici.request wrapped in p-retry that retries 429, 5xx and network errors but aborts on other 4xx, tested offline with undici MockAgent, disableNetConnect and assertNoPendingInterceptors.

results.title: Boltons retry decorator and cached property helpers under pytest
results.summary: A signature-preserving retry decorator composed with boltons.funcutils.wraps, plus cacheutils cachedproperty and cachedmethod memoization tested offline with pytest.

results.title: http-errors with Express error middleware
results.summary: Express routes that throw http-errors and reject asynchronously, mapped by a central middleware to RFC 7807 problem details with expose-aware messages and a 500 fallback, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: Vitest fake timers with es-toolkit debounce, throttle and retry
results.summary: Test time-based helpers from es-toolkit (debounce, throttle, delay, retry) deterministically with Vitest fake timers, advanceTimersByTime and setSystemTime, without real waiting.

results.title: cockatiel retry, circuit breaker and timeout policies
results.summary: Compose cockatiel policies with wrap(): retries with backoff, a consecutive-failure circuit breaker that throws BrokenCircuitError, and an aggressive timeout, all with real but tiny delays.

results.title: tenacity Retrying with stop_after_attempt and wait_exponential
results.summary: Build a tenacity Retrying policy that stops after N attempts, backs off exponentially and only retries transient exception types, then prove the behavior offline under pytest.

results.title: httpx + tenacity async retries honoring Retry-After, tested with respx
results.summary: Wrap async httpx calls in tenacity AsyncRetrying that retries 429 and 5xx, honors Retry-After, and patches the wait to zero in tests with respx mocks.

results.title: httpx client + tenacity retries with backoff, tested with respx
results.summary: Retry transient HTTP failures (5xx, 429, timeouts) with tenacity around an httpx client, honoring a max attempt count, tested offline with respx.
